$comment: API-to-MCP capability ledger (#77). One row per operation in the published OpenAPI contract. Checked by `npm run check:capability-ledger` against the live contract, build/capabilities.json and src/index.ts. Bump ledgerVersion and append to changes for every decision change, and link the change from the release notes.

openapi.servedBy: OilpriceAPI/oilpriceapi-api ApplicationController#swagger_spec: swagger/v1/swagger.json plus discovery samples injected at runtime

routePolicy.$comment: families[].pathPrefixes and their audiences are a snapshot of this file. It is not published, so the check fails once the snapshot is older than maxAgeDays.

status.exposed: At least one registered MCP tool calls this operation (tools lists them; via names the literal path when the tool calls an alias).
status.not_exposed: No MCP tool calls it. disposition and reason are required.

disposition.selected: Chosen for an MCP addition; selection names the rank and the tracking issue.
disposition.deferred: A candidate, not scheduled. The reason states what would change the decision.
disposition.alias: Duplicates another operation the ledger already accounts for.
disposition.unsupported: Deliberately never exposed through an LLM tool.
disposition.internal: Operations or first-party plumbing, not a customer workflow.

familyStatus.exposed: Every operation in the family that the MCP needs is reachable.
familyStatus.partial: Some operations are exposed; the rest have row-level decisions.

demandEvidence.provenance: Query, population and exclusions are recorded privately in OilpriceAPI/oilpriceapi-api#8480; they describe internal schema and filtering and are kept out of this public repository.
demandEvidence.ranking: Distinct established accounts per workflow family, tie-broken by accounts with repeat use on two or more days. Account-level counts and the query are in OilpriceAPI/oilpriceapi-api#8480.
rankedUnexposedFamilies: 2 futures settlement history (selected; ahead of marine and commodity detail on repeat and paid accounts)
3 marine ports, all-port prices and history (selected; tied with commodity detail on accounts, ahead on repeat use)
5 spreads and indicators beyond current crack/basis/margin (deferred)
no measured demand: natural-gas fundamentals, macro, /v1/forecasts, webhooks, well-lifecycle state/cohort views
demandEvidence.excludedFromRanking: GET /v1/analytics/performance had broad but shallow traffic (about three calls per account, little repeat use). It is account usage analytics, not a market-data workflow, and not in the canonical contract.

selections.workflow: Marine ports, all-port prices and marine-fuel history

families.title: Spot, fixed-window and date-range prices
families.reason: Latest, all-prices and fixed past_* windows are exposed; date-range and paginated history are selection 1.

families.title: Keyless demo and discovery samples
families.reason: Keyless tools serve GET /v1/demo/prices; per-code demo and runtime discovery samples are aliases.

families.title: Commodity catalogue, detail and coverage
families.reason: Catalogue is exposed; per-code detail and coverage are the next candidates after the selections.

families.title: Oil storage (Cushing, SPR)
families.reason: Cushing is canonical OpenAPI; SPR is served from the preview storage family.

families.title: Canonical futures (Brent, WTI, NYMEX natural gas)
families.reason: Latest contracts are exposed; settlement history is selection 2; calendar spreads are deferred.

families.title: Expanded futures: gasoil, TTF, JKM, carbon, forward curves, OHLC and intraday
families.reason: Latest and curve for all eight instruments are exposed through preview /v1/futures/{slug} and /curve routes. OHLC, intraday and non-canonical history stay deferred until the API publishes stable schemas (route policy: product_preview).

families.title: European gasoil crack spread
families.reason: Canonical operation exists (GET /v1/spreads/gasoil-crack) but measured demand is low; candidate to fold into opa_get_spread.

families.title: Marine fuels and ports
families.reason: Latest prices are exposed through the compatibility alias /v1/marine-fuels/latest; ports, all-port prices and history are selection 3, which also moves the tool to the canonical path.

families.title: LTL and parcel carrier fuel surcharges
families.reason: All six canonical operations are reachable through opa_get_fuel_surcharge.

families.title: Rig counts and drilling intelligence
families.reason: Latest rig counts and the drilling summary are exposed; basin-level detail and rig-count history are deferred.

families.title: Webhook endpoints
families.reason: Delivery to customer infrastructure is configuration, not an agent action; price watches are exposed as subscriptions.

families.title: API key management
families.reason: Secrets are never issued, listed or rotated through an LLM tool call.

families.title: Regional retail diesel, gasoline and electricity
families.reason: State diesel is reachable through opa_get_diesel_by_state on /v1/prices/latest; the regional endpoints had little or no measured demand.

families.title: Account status
families.reason: opa_get_account_status reads /v1/dashboard, which the API route policy classifies as browser-session dashboard data. It answers with an API key today (verified 2026-09-13); the documented GET /v1/account is deferred.

families.title: Plans and limits
families.reason: opa_get_plans reads the website pricing helper /v1/pricing; GET /v1/meta/limits is deferred.

families.title: Multi-commodity market brief
families.reason: Canonical operation exposed; the underscore alias is recorded as an alias.

families.title: Price-watch subscription lifecycle
families.reason: Create, list, delete and event polling are exposed under --scope write/read; update, pause and resume need a write-scope decision.

families.title: Legacy price alerts
families.reason: Served from the preview /v1/alerts family, which the API route policy calls legacy in favour of subscriptions. Kept for existing MCP users; a deprecation decision is open.

families.title: Well production
families.reason: Summary, states, wells, top producers and cycle-time operations are exposed; /summary is an alias.

families.title: FracFocus, permits and well lifecycle
families.reason: Per-well lifecycle and the preview permit family are exposed; lifecycle state availability and cohorts are deferred.

families.title: Crack, basis, margin, curve-structure and physical-premium spreads
families.reason: Current crack, basis and margin are exposed; history, all-series, curve-structure and physical-premium views are deferred on low demand.

families.title: Analyst indicators (fuel switching, price context, storage analytics, CFTC, annotations)
families.reason: Ten canonical operations with low or no measured demand; no MCP tool yet.

families.title: Forecasts
families.reason: EIA short-term forecasts are exposed through the preview /v1/ei/forecasts route. The separate /v1/forecasts model family is deferred: no stable schema and no measured demand.

families.title: Energy intelligence (OPEC production, inventories)
families.reason: Served from the preview /v1/ei family, which has no canonical OpenAPI operations yet.

families.title: US natural-gas hub prices
families.reason: Served from the preview /v1/natural-gas family.

families.title: Natural-gas fundamentals
families.reason: Preview family (/v1/fundamentals) with no stable response schema and no measured demand in the selection window.

families.title: Macro calendar
families.reason: Preview family (/v1/macro) with no stable response schema and no measured demand in the selection window.

families.title: Data-quality reports
families.reason: Served from the preview /v1/data-quality family.
